title: Shoutout to the guy next to me in the theatre who was having the time...
transcript: Guess who just got to see shucked in the right order. Oh, my gosh, what a treat. Just got to L A. Today and found out that the Shucked Tour was in town, so obviously, I had to go see it Act 1 to Act 2 as opposed to the other way around. As a treat, got to see the incredible Zakeya Baptista's Lulu today and got to see Tyler Joseph Ellis for the first time because he was out the entire Atlanta run. Also, I absolutely love getting to see shucked in different cities because, uh, all of the different cities kind of react differently. And I realized that I'm definitely from LA because I feel like people were laughing at jokes that I used to be the only one laughing at, and I was like, oh, oh, humor is culture based. 우후
